result.summary: ChatGPT delivers a complete multimodal platform equipped with real-time voice, image creation, web browsing, and a deep third-party ecosystem. Claude focuses on core reasoning, offering industry-leading code generation, long-context understanding, and interactive editing tools via Artifacts. Both platforms cost $20 per month for individual subscriptions, making them equally strong choices depending on workflow requirements.
result.recommendation: Select ChatGPT if you require voice chat, image generation, and plugin extensions; opt for Claude if your primary tasks involve writing, editing, or complex software programming.
